黑桃SPADE ♠\spadesuit ：自适应合成可执行环境中的自我游戏: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

Bo Liu    Simon Yu    Yiding Jiang    Ao Qu    Andrew Zhao    Zichen Liu    Junsu Kim    Zijian Zhou    Seungone Kim    Tongzheng Ren    Mickel Liu    Hanfei Yu    Zhaorun Chen    Weiyan Shi    Paul Pu Liang    Luke Zettlemoyer    Yejin Choi    Natasha Jaques Email: benjaminliu.eecs@gmail.com Email: nj@cs.washington.edu
摘要Abstract

持续的自我完善需要不断扩大的自我生成的、多样化的、适应性的目标。对于语言代理，现有的训练环境池（手工策划、静态合成或冻结验证器）使目标分布随着学习者的扩展而保持固定。我们介绍Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce黑桃SPADE（自适应合成可执行环境中的自我游戏），一种自我游戏 RL 框架，其中单个 LLM 扮演两个角色：(Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an环境设计师Environment Designer使用 OpenAI Gym 风格将完整的长期训练环境编写为可执行代码that writes complete, long-horizon training environments as executable code with an OpenAI Gym-style重置（）reset()/步骤（）step()接口，以及一个interface, and a推理代理Reasoning Agent学会在其中行动。每个都是一个有状态的多回合环境（状态转换、奖励函数和验证码），因此一个界面涵盖推理问题和多步骤代理工具的使用。的that learns to act in them. Each is a stateful, multi-turn environment (state transitions, reward functions, and verification code), so one interface spans reasoning problems and multi-step agentic tool use. The推理代理Reasoning Agent的遗憾是利用有特权提示和没有特权提示的奖励之间的差距来估计的；在优化这个遗憾信号时’s regret is estimated using the gap between its reward with and without privileged hints; in optimizing this regret signal the环境设计师Environment Designer学习以代理能力边缘的环境为目标，同时保持它们的可行性。通过广泛的实验，我们发现了几个对成功至关重要的组成部分：learns to target environments at the edge of the agent’s capabilities while keeping them feasible. Through extensive experimentation, we find several components critical to success: grounding the环境设计师Environment Designer对从大型预训练语料库中采样的文档进行分析，并为其提供累积的环境记忆。扩展到 30B 参数模型，on documents sampled from a large pretraining corpus, and giving it an accumulated environment memory. Scaling to 30B-parameter models,黑桃SPADE改进了最强的固定环境基线improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by+5.3+5.3平均在八个保留的数学、科学、代码和推理基准中，并将工具使用设置提升了on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks, and lifts the tool-use setting by+5.7+5.7在 BFCL v4 多圈和on BFCL v4 multi-turn and+13.9+13.9在 ACEBench-Agent 上；在游戏设置中，最强基线的差距随着模型规模的增加而增长。通过使环境设计本身成为一个可学习的组成部分，on ACEBench-Agent; on the games setting, the margin over the strongest baseline grows with model scale. By making environment design itself a learnable component,黑桃SPADE朝着开放式自我完善迈出了具体的一步。takes a concrete step toward open-ended self-improvement.

1 简介Introduction

代理人工智能已经变得具有广泛的能力：语言模型现在可以进行长期推理、使用工具、搜索网络和操作计算机Agentic AI has become broadly capable: language models now reason over long horizons, use tools, search the web, and operate computers(OpenAI 2024; DeepSeek-AI 2025; Wang et al. 2025c; Zhang et al. 2025c)。这些收益越来越不仅仅来自预训练，而是来自通过经验学习，其中模型根据其自身与环境交互的轨迹及其返回的奖励进行改进. These gains increasingly come not from pretraining alone but from learning through experience, where a model improves from its own trajectories of interacting with an environment and the rewards they return(Silver and Sutton 2025)。由于高质量的人类文本是有限的资源. As high-quality human text is a finite resource(Villalobos et al. 2024)，进一步代理进步的瓶颈日益成为训练环境的提供：具有可验证奖励的交互式任务。建造它们已成为一项核心行业投资，主要实验室每年权衡的环境预算超过 10 亿美元，而一类新的初创公司筹集了九位数的资金来供应它们, the bottleneck for further agentic progress is increasingly the supply of training environments: interactive tasks with verifiable rewards. Building them has become a central industry investment, with major labs weighing environment budgets exceeding $1 billion a year and a new class of startups raising nine figures to supply them(Zeff 2025; PYMNTS 2026)。然而，无论是手工构建的还是合成的，这些环境都会形成一个固定的池，不会随着学习者的改进而适应，因此一旦耗尽它们，代理就会停止改进。. Yet whether hand-built or synthesized, these environments form a fixed pool that does not adapt as the learner improves, so an agent stops improving once it exhausts them.

有几项工作试图让代理不断进步，但每项工作都有其局限性。Several lines of work try to keep agents improving, each with its own limitation.线束工程Harness engineering通过工具编排和自我纠正，改进智能体在推理时在给定环境中的行为方式improves how an agent acts within a given environment at inference time, through tool orchestration and self-correction(Yao et al. 2023; Shinn et al. 2023)，但它不会改变权重，因此它的增益与每个手工构建的工具相关，而不是提高模型执行新任务的一般能力。, but it changes no weights, so its gains are tied to each hand-built harness, rather than improving general capabilities the model carries to new tasks.人为策划的扩展Human-curated scaling (Zhang et al. 2025a; Guertler et al. 2025; Liu et al. 2025c)构建不同的环境来进行训练，但扩展速度只能与人们编写它们的速度一样快。builds diverse environments to train across, but scales only as fast as people can write them.合成一代Synthetic generation (Wang et al. 2026b; Tu et al. 2026; Zhu et al. 2026; Gandhi et al. 2026; Zeng et al. 2025)以编程方式生成环境，但生成器是固定的，因此环境空间不会随着代理的增长而增长，模型很快就会耗尽它produces environments programmatically, but the generators are fixed, so the environment space does not grow with the agent and the model soon exhausts it(Song et al. 2024). 自玩Self-play (Zhao et al. 2025; Huang et al. 2025; Liu et al. 2025a)让模型通过双重角色来改进，但无根据的自我博弈受到信息对称的限制，无法提出超出其自身知识的挑战，并且容易放大其错误lets a model improve through dual roles, but ungrounded self-play is bounded by information symmetry, unable to pose challenges beyond its own knowledge and prone to amplifying its errors(Chae et al. 2025);语料库接地可以缓解这种情况; corpus grounding mitigates this(Liu et al. 2025b)，但大多数方法仍然生成, yet most methods still generate任务tasks（最终奖励稀疏的问题）而不是完整的(a problem with a sparse terminal reward) rather than complete多轮环境multi-turn environments（状态转换、奖励函数和验证码）。没有一个系统能够产生自我改进的系统，其环境随着代理的改进而不断变得复杂。(state transitions, reward functions, and verification code). None produces a self-improving system whose environments keep growing in complexity as the agent improves.

我们介绍We introduce黑桃SPADE（自适应合成可执行环境中的自我游戏），一个框架，其中单个法学硕士扮演两个角色：(Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a framework where a single LLM plays two roles: an环境设计师Environment Designer生成完整的训练环境作为可执行的Python代码，以及that produces complete training environments as executable Python code, and a推理代理Reasoning Agent向他们学习。每个环境都实现一个 Gym 风格的界面（标准that learns from them. Each environment implements a Gym-style interface (the standard重置（）reset()/步骤（）step()强化学习中使用的API）API used in reinforcement learning)(Brockman et al. 2016)，代表具有状态转换和奖励函数的完整马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。这个, representing a full Markov decision process (MDP) with state transitions and reward functions. This代码即环境code-as-environment表示将单轮设置（一步到达最终奖励）和多轮代理任务（与过渡动态的顺序交互）统一在一个界面下。因为任何可计算的 MDP 都可以编写为程序，representation unifies single-turn settings (one step to terminal reward) and multi-turn agentic tasks (sequential interaction with transition dynamics) under a single interface. Because any computable MDP can be written as a program, the环境设计师Environment Designer可以在代码中表达任何此类环境，而不仅仅是手工设计的参数化允许的环境。与之前的环境生成器被冻结的作品不同，can express any such environment in code, rather than only those a hand-designed parameterization allows. Unlike prior works where the environment generator is frozen,黑桃SPADE’s 环境设计师Environment Designer本身是通过 RL 进行训练的is itself trained via RL with a基于暗示的后悔hint-based regret信号精确地针对边界的可解环境signal that targets solvable environments precisely at the frontier of the推理代理Reasoning Agent的能力，创造共同进化，其中环境分布随着’s capability, creating co-evolution where the environment distribution shifts as the推理代理Reasoning Agent改善（图improves (Figure2).

总的来说，我们的工作做出了以下贡献：Overall, our work makes the following contributions:

  1. 1.

    我们介绍一个We introduce a通过自我游戏共同进化环境综合和代理能力的总体框架general framework for co-evolving environments synthesis and agentic capability through self-play，其中同一个法学硕士既生成可执行环境作为代码，又学习解决它们。通过将环境表示为具有 Gym 风格界面的 Python 程序，该框架统一了单轮推理和多轮代理任务，并将环境设计转变为训练后可学习的、经过 RL 训练的组件，从而实现持续的开放式自我改进。, where the same LLM both generates executable environments as code and learns to solve them. By representing environments as Python programs with a Gym-style interface, the framework unifies single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic tasks, and turns environment design into a learnable, RL-trained component of post-training, enabling continual open-ended self-improvement.

  2. 2.

    我们介绍一个We introduce a基于提示的后悔奖励hint-based regret reward为for the环境设计师Environment Designer。的. The环境设计师Environment Designer是由之间的差距奖励is rewarded by the gap between推理代理Reasoning Agent有或没有特权提示的性能，极小极大遗憾的轻量级估计performance with and without privileged hints, a lightweight estimate of minimax regret(Dennis et al. 2020)以边界环境为目标that targets environments at the frontier of the推理代理Reasoning Agent的能力。与纯粹的对手不同，后者可以随意使环境变得无法解决，也不同于合作设计师，后者可以使环境膨胀’s capability. Unlike a pure adversary, which is free to make environments unsolvable, or a cooperative designer, which can inflate推理代理Reasoning Agent奖励而不教它任何东西，基于提示的遗憾会产生受限的竞争动态，奖励既可解决又处于学习前沿的环境，附录中的均衡分析reward without teaching it anything, hint-based regret yields constrained competitive dynamics that reward environments which are both solvable and at the learning frontier, with an equilibrium analysis in AppendixE.

  3. 3.

    我们设计了一个We design a基于语料库和内存增强的设计流程corpus-grounded and memory-augmented design pipeline涵盖认知技能游戏和工具使用任务。如果先前的环境生成工作针对单个领域（数学、代码或工具使用），spanning cognitive-skill games and tool-use tasks. Where prior environment-generation work targets a single domain (math, code, or tool use),黑桃SPADE展示了两种环境的改进，环境基于预训练语料库知识和积累的经验。demonstrates improvements in both settings, with environments grounded in pretraining corpus knowledge and accumulated experience.

  4. 4.

    我们验证We validate30B+规模的自我对弈self-play working at 30B+ scale提供了实用的配方，证明该方法超越了小模型，提供了完整的培训配方，包括环境验证、奖励黑客攻击避免和课程设计。with practical recipe provided, demonstrating that the approach works beyond the small-model with a complete training recipe including environment validation, reward hacking avoidance, and curriculum design.

在游戏设定上，On the games setting,黑桃SPADE在所有三个主干上均优于固定环境基线outperforms fixed-environment baselines on all three backbones, by+5.3+5.3平均分和最高分points on average and up to+7.5+7.5在 30B-A3B 的最强固定环境基线上进行个别基准测试，在静态分布开始饱和后保留增益。在工具使用设置中，on individual benchmarks over the strongest fixed-environment baseline at 30B-A3B, with gains retained after static distributions begin to saturate. In the tool-use setting,黑桃SPADE升降机 BFCL v4 多回转lifts BFCL v4 multi-turn(Patil et al. 2025) by +10.3+10.3在 4B 和at 4B and+5.7+5.7位于 30B-A3B 和 ACEBench-Agentat 30B-A3B, and ACEBench-Agent(Chen et al. 2025a) by +13.9+13.930B-A3B。消融显示了基于提示的遗憾相对于指数移动平均 (EMA) 学习潜力信号的优势at 30B-A3B. Ablations show the advantage of hint-based regret over an exponential-moving-average (EMA) learning-potential signal(Kanitscheider et al. 2021; Zhang et al. 2023), 以及在部分和冻结设计器控件上的完全自适应、基于语料库、记忆增强的配置。定性分析揭示了新兴课程：, and of the full adaptive, corpus-grounded, memory-augmented configuration over the partial and frozen-designer controls. Qualitative analysis reveals emergent curricula:黑桃SPADE从简单的单一技能任务发展到需要长视野交互的复杂的多约束环境。progresses from simple single-skill tasks to complex multi-constraint environments requiring long-horizon interaction.

In 黑桃SPADE, 的, the环境设计师Environment Designer编写了一个新的、独立的环境writes a new, self-contained environment and the推理代理Reasoning Agent通过在其中行动来学习。让设计成为一个可学习的角色，让两者共同进化：随着智能体的改进，它训练的环境也会随之改进（图learns by acting in it. Making design a learnable role lets the two co-evolve: as the agent improves, so do the environments it trains on (Figure2）。因此，单一模型不仅改善了它的推理和行为方式，还改善了它所构建的学习世界，这是迈向开放式、持续自我完善的具体步骤。). A single model thus improves not only how it reasons and acts, but the worlds it builds to learn in, a concrete step toward open-ended, continual self-improvement.

2 相关工作Related Work

有关扩展背景以及与文献的比较，请参阅附录For an extended background and comparison to the literature see AppendixH，总结如下：, summarized here:

LLM 的自学Self-Play for LLMs自我对弈推动了 TD-Gammon 的能力增长Self-play has driven capability growth from TD-Gammon(Tesauro et al. 1995)通过阿尔法零through AlphaZero(Silver et al. 2017; Silver et al. 2018)到现代游戏人工智能to modern game AI(Vinyals et al. 2019; † et al.(2022)(FAIR)†, Bakhtin, Brown, Dinan, Farina, Flaherty, Fried, Goff, Gray, Hu, et al. FAIR)。强力播放. PowerPlay(Schmidhuber 2013)提出了一个单一的自我修改系统，该系统不断地在自己的能力前沿发明任务，预示着下面采用的双角色单法学硕士模式。非对称自我对弈proposed a single self-modifying system that continually invents tasks at its own capability frontier, prefiguring the dual-role single-LLM pattern adopted below. Asymmetric self-play(Sukhbaatar et al. 2017)后来正式提出了一种提议者-解决者范式，其中一个代理提出挑战，而另一个代理解决它们。将自我对弈应用于法学硕士比单任务游戏系统更难：目标是解决开放式问题的一般能力，而法学硕士规模的自我对弈训练通常不稳定。早期的法学硕士自我对弈方法依赖于精选的种子数据或评估集，用于自我蒸馏later formalized a proposer-solver paradigm in which one agent sets challenges while another solves them. Applying self-play to LLMs is harder than in single-task game-playing systems: the goal is general capability across open-ended problems, and self-play training at LLM scale is often unstable. Earlier LLM self-play methods rely on curated seed data or evaluation sets, either for self-distillation(Chen et al. 2024; Yuan et al. 2024; Singh et al. 2023)，针对固定词汇的对抗性语言游戏, for adversarial language games over fixed vocabularies(Cheng et al. 2024)，或者用于引导一个有学识的提议者, or for bootstrapping a learned proposer(Fang et al. 2025b; Sundaram et al. 2026)。最近的一条线路消除了这种依赖性，用针对可学习前沿的代理奖励从最小种子中训练提议者和求解器。 AZR. A more recent line removes this dependency, training proposer and solver from minimal seeds with proxy rewards that target the learnable frontier. AZR(Zhao et al. 2025), SQLM (Chen et al. 2025c)、语言自我对弈, and Language Self-Play(Kuba et al. 2025)让一个法学硕士同时扮演两个角色并共享参数； R-零have a single LLM play both roles with shared parameters; R-Zero(Huang et al. 2025)和工具-R0and Tool-R0(Acikgoz et al. 2026)相反，使用基于不确定性或解决率的奖励来训练从同一基础初始化的两个单独的模型。与我们的工作最接近的前辈是 SPIRALinstead train two separate models initialized from the same base, using uncertainty- or solve-rate-based rewards. The closest predecessors to our work are SPIRAL(Liu et al. 2025a)，通过多回合零和语言游戏的自我对弈来训练法学硕士，以及 SPICE, which trains LLMs through self-play on multi-turn zero-sum language games, and SPICE(Liu et al. 2025b)，它将自我游戏扩展到基于语料库的问题生成。然而，两者都会产生, which extends self-play to corpus-grounded question generation. The推理代理Reasoning Agent通过多次调用工具来解决环境问题，并且仅在完成每个用户指令时才会获得奖励。特权提示是一个逐步计划（查找记录，更新它，然后协调结果），因此solves an environment by calling tools over multiple turns and is rewarded only when it completes every user instruction. The privileged hint is a step-by-step plan (look up a record, update it, then reconcile the result), so the推理代理Reasoning Agent仍然需要通过调用工具来找到确切的参数。验证在游戏检查之外添加了两项检查：确定性重置门，在多个种子下执行每个成功标准，以及 LLM 检查某些工具可以满足每个成功标准（详细信息参见附录）still has to find the exact arguments by calling the tools. Validation adds two checks beyond the game ones: a deterministic reset gate that exercises every success criterion under several seeds, and an LLM check that every success criterion can be met by some tool (details in AppendixF.2）。生成提示针对评估套件的多轮函数调用任务系列（架构定义的模拟工具、后端状态和每条指令检查）；没有基准任务或数据显示给). 的The推理代理Reasoning Agent学会根据证据采取行动，而不是提前得出结论。learns to act on evidence rather than derive in advance.图Figure10显示了shows the推理代理Reasoning Agent同一次跑步的一侧。在第 0 步，它完全预先推理，并且一旦接口拒绝其答案就无法恢复；在步骤200，它测试简短的假设并在结果返回时修改它们；到步骤300，它首先收集证据，并在证据足够时导出一次。这种转变仅出现在任务奖励推理的情况下：在程序环境中，相同的策略在短命令中起作用（后期中位数’s side of the same run. At step 0 it reasons entirely up front and cannot recover once the interface rejects its answer; by step 200 it tests short hypotheses and revises them as results return; by step 300 it gathers evidence first and derives once, when the evidence is enough. The shift appears only where the task rewards inference: on procedural environments the same policy acts in short commands (late-step median88代币）。当任务需要时，模型仍然会详细导出，并且后期检查点基准增益（表tokens). The model still derives at length when the task calls for it, and the late-checkpoint benchmark gains (Table1）确认其保持该能力。) confirm it keeps the ability.

9 讨论Discussion

黑桃SPADE的结果支持两个结论。首先，训练’s results support two conclusions. First, training the环境设计师Environment Designer创造适应环境to produce environments adapted to the推理代理Reasoning Agent目前的能力优于在一组固定环境下的训练（表’s current ability outperforms both training on a fixed set of environments (Table1, 部分, Section6.1）以及来自冻结设计者的合成环境训练，即使该设计者是更强的前沿模型（GPT-5.5；表) and training on synthetic environments from a frozen designer, even when that designer is a stronger frontier model (GPT-5.5; Table3, 部分, Section7）。原因在于适应性：不断适应环境的环境). The reason is adaptivity: environments that keep adapting to the推理代理Reasoning Agent在固定池停止改善后维持收益。其次，一个代码即环境界面跨越两种截然不同的设置。在游戏设定中，推理能力sustain gains after fixed pools stop improving. Second, one code-as-environment interface spans two very different settings. In the games setting, reasoning skills the推理代理Reasoning Agent开发（规划、约束满足、战略思维）泛化到数学、科学和代码，远远超出了他们所学习的游戏格式。在工具使用环境中，相同的方法在交互最重要的地方提升了多步骤代理基准，通过develops (planning, constraint satisfaction, strategic thinking) generalize to held-out mathematics, science, and code, well beyond the game format they were learned in. In the tool-use setting, the same recipe lifts multi-step agentic benchmarks most where interaction matters, by+13.9+13.9在 ACEBench-Agent 上和on ACEBench-Agent and+5.7+5.7在 BFCL v4 上多匝，位于 30B-A3B。让环境设计成为一个可学习的角色可以推动两者的进步。on BFCL v4 multi-turn at 30B-A3B. Making environment design a learnable role drives gains in both.

局限性。Limitations.(一)(a)复杂性受到规模和无形束缚的限制Complexity bounded by scale and the invisible leash (Chae et al. 2025)。的. The环境设计师Environment Designer无法生成比其基本模型在上下文中可以表达的更复杂的环境，因此可达到的环境复杂性随着模型规模和生成预算而增加。 (二)cannot produce environments more complex than its base model can express in context, so reachable environment complexity grows with model scale and generation budget. (b)人为设计的优化器。A human-designed optimizer.这两个角色均由固定的、人类编写的 RL 算法 (GRPO) 进行更新；Both roles are updated by a fixed, human-authored RL algorithm (GRPO);黑桃SPADE不修改自己的学习规则。 (三)does not modify its own learning rule. (c)没有正式的最优性和固定任务评估。No formal optimality, and fixed-task evaluation.基于提示的后悔是由 PAIRED 激发的Hint-based regret is motivated by PAIRED(Dennis et al. 2020)但尚未被证明可以产生最佳课程，并且当前的基准衡量的是固定任务的表现，而不是开放式推理的增长。but not proven to yield an optimal curriculum, and current benchmarks measure fixed-task performance rather than open-ended reasoning growth.

未来的方向。Future directions.我们改进了We improve the环境设计师Environment Designer具有梯度更新，但之间的共同适应with gradient updates, but co-adaptation between the环境设计师Environment Designer和and推理代理Reasoning Agent也可能来自might also come from an环境设计师Environment Designer无需权重更新即可改进，根据过去的尝试积累和完善设计策略；学习权重或上下文进化是否能造就更好的设计师，以及在多大程度上，是一个悬而未决的问题。that improves without weight updates, accumulating and refining design strategies from past attempts in context; whether learned weights or in-context evolution makes the better designer, and at what scale, is an open question.黑桃SPADE还可以自动化一个阶段的后期培训；将自适应环境设计与自动化剩余阶段（从数据管理到学习规则本身）的系统相结合，可以将自适应自我游戏扩展到整个训练流程。also automates one stage of post-training; combining adaptive environment design with systems that automate the remaining stages, from data curation through the learning rule itself, could extend co-adaptive self-play across the whole training pipeline.

10 结论Conclusion

我们提出了We presented黑桃SPADE，一个框架，使环境设计成为法学硕士后培训的可通过自我游戏学习的组成部分。三个贡献可以实现这一点：（1）基于提示的后悔奖励，可以训练, a framework that makes environment design a learnable component of LLM post-training through self-play. Three contributions enable this: (1) a hint-based regret reward that trains the环境设计师Environment Designer创造环境to produce environments at the推理代理Reasoning Agent的学习前沿，基于极小极大遗憾理论； （2）基于预训练语料库和环境记忆的环境设计，具有统一单轮和多轮设置的代码即环境接口； (3) Qwen3 型号上 30B+ 规模的实用配方。’s learning frontier, grounded in minimax regret theory; (2) environment design anchored in a pretraining corpus and an environment memory, with a code-as-environment interface that unifies single-turn and multi-turn settings; and (3) a practical recipe at 30B+ scale on Qwen3 models.黑桃SPADE在固定环境基线开始饱和后保持其收益，将保留的推理和代码基准提高retains its gains after fixed-environment baselines begin to saturate, raising held-out reasoning and code benchmarks by+8.1+8.1平均分超过基础 30B-A3B (average points over base at 30B-A3B (+5.2+5.2和and+5.7+5.74B 和 8B），与最强固定环境基线的差距随着规模的扩大而增长；相同的方法将多步骤工具使用基准提升了at 4B and 8B), with the margin over the strongest fixed-environment baseline growing with scale; the same recipe lifts multi-step tool-use benchmarks by+13.9+13.9在 ACEBench-Agent 上和on ACEBench-Agent and+5.7+5.7在 BFCL v4 多圈上。on BFCL v4 multi-turn.

黑桃SPADE表明单个模型可以设计自己的训练环境并从中进行改进，这是从固定基准迈向开放式、持续自我改进的一步。shows that a single model can design its own training environments and improve from them, a step from fixed benchmarks toward open-ended, continual self-improvement.

We model the interaction between the环境设计师Environment Designer和and推理代理Reasoning Agent作为两人游戏：as a two-player game: the环境设计师Environment Designer选择环境分布，而selects an environment distribution, while the推理代理Reasoning Agent选择一个策略。由于 LLM 推理是随机的，因此所有收益都是通过预期验证者回报来定义的。selects a policy. Since LLM inference is stochastic, all payoffs are defined through expected verifier returns.

H.1 LLM 的自学Self-Play for LLMs

自那时以来，自我对弈一直是人工智能的基石Self-play has been a cornerstone of AI sinceTesauro et al. 1995通过双陆棋自我对弈训练 TD-Gammon。阿尔法围棋trained TD-Gammon through self-play in backgammon. AlphaGo(Silver et al. 2016)将蒙特卡洛树搜索与深度神经网络和自对弈相结合，击败了人类围棋冠军，以及 AlphaZerocombined Monte Carlo tree search with deep neural networks and self-play to defeat a human Go champion, and AlphaZero(Silver et al. 2017; Silver et al. 2018)在没有人类数据的情况下，将白板的方法扩展到国际象棋、将棋和围棋。开放人工智能五extended the approach to chess, shogi, and Go from tabula rasa with no human data. OpenAI Five(Berner et al. 2019)和阿尔法星and AlphaStar(Vinyals et al. 2019)将多智能体自我对战扩展到 Dota 2 和 StarCraft II，而 Ciceroscaled multi-agent self-play to Dota 2 and StarCraft II, while Cicero(† et al.(2022)(FAIR)†, Bakhtin, Brown, Dinan, Farina, Flaherty, Fried, Goff, Gray, Hu, et al. FAIR)将语言模型与外交中的战略推理相结合。combined language models with strategic reasoning in Diplomacy.Littman 1994形式化了这些结果背后的马尔可夫博弈框架，并且formalized the Markov-game framework underlying these results, andIrving et al. 2018提出了关于基于自我博弈的人工智能安全机制的争论。非对称自我博弈范式proposed debate as an AI-safety mechanism grounded in self-play. The asymmetric self-play paradigm ofSukhbaatar et al. 2017，其中一个代理提出挑战，另一个代理解决挑战，为师生环境设计提供了概念模板。, in which one agent proposes challenges while another solves them, provides the conceptual template for teacher-student environment design.

将自我对弈转化为法学硕士带来了新的挑战，因为奖励稀疏，输出是离散序列，并且“环境”是开放式语言。旋转Translating self-play to LLMs introduces new challenges because rewards are sparse, outputs are discrete sequences, and the “environment” is open-ended language. SPIN(Chen et al. 2024)通过训练 LLM 区分自己的输出和人类演示，将弱模型转换为强模型，从而应用自我对弈微调。自我奖励语言模型applies self-play fine-tuning by training the LLM to distinguish its own outputs from human demonstrations, converting weak models to strong ones. Self-Rewarding Language Models(Yuan et al. 2024)让法学硕士判断自己的输出以生成偏好数据，迭代改进生成和评估。 SPAGlet the LLM judge its own outputs to generate preference data, iteratively improving both generation and evaluation. SPAG(Cheng et al. 2024)使用对抗性语言游戏（对抗性禁忌）通过零和目标来激励战略推理。恢复期uses adversarial language games (Adversarial Taboo) to incentivize strategic reasoning through a zero-sum objective. ReSTEM (Singh et al. 2023)在通过二进制正确性奖励过滤的采样模型解决方案和对过滤后的正确性部署进行监督微调之间交替。证明者-验证者游戏alternates between sampling model solutions filtered by a binary correctness reward and supervised fine-tuning on the filtered correct rollouts. Prover-Verifier Games(Kirchner et al. 2024)训练证明者产生清晰的解决方案，较弱的验证者可以检查，从而提高输出的可解释性。雷玛train a prover to produce legible solutions that a weaker verifier can check, improving output interpretability. ReMA(Wan et al. 2025)通过多智能体强化学习将推理分解为高级元思维智能体（策略和分解）和低级推理智能体（逐步执行），并进行联合训练。decomposes reasoning via multi-agent RL into a high-level meta-thinking agent (strategy and decomposition) and a low-level reasoning agent (step-by-step execution), trained jointly.

最近最相关的工作是使用法学硕士作为自己的自我对弈训练数据源，并不同程度地依赖外部数据。在一种极端情况下，完全无数据的方法从最小种子引导：绝对零推理器 (AZR)The most relevant line of recent work uses LLMs as their own source of training data in self-play, with varying degrees of reliance on external data. At one extreme, fully data-free methods bootstrap from minimal seeds: Absolute Zero Reasoner (AZR)(Zhao et al. 2025)具有单一模型（共享参数） 提出并解决具有提议者奖励的代码推理三元组（演绎、溯因、归纳）has a single model (shared parameters) propose and solve code-reasoning triplets (deduction, abduction, induction) with proposer reward1−r¯solve1-\bar{r}_{\text{solve}}由代码执行器验证的求解器蒙特卡罗成功率计算得出，从单个恒等函数引导。 R-零computed from solver Monte-Carlo success rates verified by a code executor, bootstrapping from a single identity function. R-Zero(Huang et al. 2025)相反，将挑战者和求解器实例化为同一基础 LLM 的两个独立优化的副本，通过 GRPO 训练挑战者并提供自我一致性的不确定性奖励；该论文报告称，这种双模型设计在消融方面优于单模型变体，但在几次迭代后趋于稳定。流行LoRAinstead instantiates a Challenger and a Solver as two independently optimized copies of the same base LLM, training the Challenger via GRPO with a self-consistency uncertainty reward; the paper reports that this two-model design outperforms a single-model variant in ablations but plateaus after a few iterations. PopuLoRA(Castanyer et al. 2026)将这种不对称范式扩展到 LoRA 适配器教师和学生的共同进化群体，并在子群体之间进行交叉评估。在相关但机械上不同的系列中，G-Zeroextends this asymmetric paradigm to co-evolving populations of LoRA-adapter teachers and students with cross-evaluation between sub-populations. In a related but mechanistically distinct line, G-Zero(Huang et al. 2026)对提示诱导的偏好对执行基于 DPO 的自蒸馏：通过 GRPO 训练的提议者发出提示performs DPO-based self-distillation over hint-induced preference pairs: a Proposer trained via GRPO emits a hinthh用于查询for queryqq, 生成器, the GeneratorπG\pi_{G}产生独立反应produces both an unassisted responseahard∼πG(⋅∣q)a_{\text{hard}}\sim\pi_{G}(\cdot\mid q)和提示条件响应and a hint-conditional responseaassisted∼πG(⋅∣q,h)a_{\text{assisted}}\sim\pi_{G}(\cdot\mid q,h)，并且 DPO 应用于, and DPO is applied withaassisteda_{\text{assisted}}作为选择和as chosen andaharda_{\text{hard}}被拒绝；提议者的奖励是提示-as rejected; the Proposer’s reward is Hint-δ\delta，每个标记的平均对数概率变化, the per-token mean log-probability shift induced onaharda_{\text{hard}}当提示被添加到生成器的上下文中时。所有监督均源自单个模型在有提示和无提示情况下的输出，使该方法更接近自我奖励和自我蒸馏线when the hint is prepended to the Generator’s context. All supervision is derived from a single model’s own outputs under hint vs no-hint contexts, placing the method closer to the self-rewarding and self-distillation line(Chen et al. 2024; Yuan et al. 2024; Singh et al. 2023)而不是基于验证者的代理环境共同进化。工具-R0than to verifier-grounded agent-environment co-evolution. Tool-R0(Acikgoz et al. 2026)采用相同的挑战者-求解器范式来适应工具使用，使用求解率带奖励加上语义对齐分数来训练生成器，并使用软工具调用匹配来训练求解器，同样发现单独的参数优于共享权重设置。自问语言模型adapts the same Challenger-Solver paradigm to tool use, training the generator with a solve-rate-band reward plus a semantic alignment score and the solver with soft tool-call matching, similarly finding that separate parameters outperform a shared-weight setup. Self-Questioning Language Models(Chen et al. 2025c)有一个模型仅根据主题提示提出并解决问题，提议者因多数票校准而获得奖励（问题既不总是解决也不总是错过）。语言自玩have a single model propose and solve problems from only a topic prompt, with the proposer rewarded for majority-vote calibration (problems neither always solved nor always missed). Language Self-Play(Kuba et al. 2025)提出了一个无数据框架，其中问题生成和答案改进相互促进。多布尔舞proposes a data-free framework where question generation and answer improvement reinforce each other. PasoDoble(Zhang et al. 2025d)将基于预训练知识库的对抗性提议器和求解器配对，持续改进 R-Zero 的平台期。在另一个极端，保留有限种子数据或策划评估集的方法包括 SeRLpairs an adversarial proposer and solver grounded in a pretraining knowledge base, sustaining improvement beyond R-Zero’s plateau. At the other extreme, methods that retain limited seed data or curated evaluation sets include SeRL(Fang et al. 2025b)，它使用带有难度带过滤器的几次提示问题生成器，并通过 Reinforce++ 根据 500 条种子指令的多数投票奖励仅训练求解器，以及, which uses a few-shot-prompted question generator with a difficulty-band filter and trains only the solver via Reinforce++ on majority-vote rewards from 500 seed instructions, andSundaram et al. 2026，他们将教师的奖励基于衡量学生在策划的目标问题上的进步，而不是代理统计数据。自我挑战的语言模型代理, who ground the teacher’s reward in measured student improvement on curated target problems instead of proxy statistics. Self-Challenging Language Model Agents(Zhou et al. 2025)让智能体为自己提出更难的任务变体，然后尝试解决它们。自动数据let agents propose harder task variants for themselves and then attempt to solve them. Autodata(Kulikov et al. 2026)通过将 LLM 代理塑造为迭代构建训练数据的元优化数据科学家，概括了自指导线；其代理自指令实例化通过强参考解算器和弱参考解算器之间的分离来选择示例，针对可学习的示例而不是仅困难的示例，类似于前沿目标原则generalizes the self-instruct line by casting an LLM agent as a meta-optimizing data scientist that iteratively constructs training data; its Agentic Self-Instruct instantiation selects examples by the separation between a strong and a weak reference solver, targeting learnable examples over merely hard ones, a frontier-targeting principle analogous to黑桃SPADE基于提示的遗憾，但使用固定参考解算器对离线数据创建进行操作，而没有梯度训练生成器的在线共同进化。零愿景’s hint-based regret but operating over offline data creation with fixed reference solvers, without the online co-evolution of a gradient-trained generator. Vision-Zero(Wang et al. 2025a)通过迭代自我对弈策略优化，将游戏化的多智能体自我对弈（谁是间谍？）引入视觉语言模型。咒语brings gamified multi-agent self-play (Who Is the Spy?) to vision-language models with iterative self-play policy optimization. SPELL(Yang et al. 2025)在长文档上共同训练一个三角色的自我游戏循环（提问者、应答者、验证者），使用历史记忆课程来生成逐渐困难的问题，以发展长上下文能力。程控co-trains a three-role self-play loop (questioner, responder, verifier) on long documents, using a history-memory curriculum to generate progressively harder questions for evolving long-context capabilities. SPC(Chen et al. 2025b)通过对抗性游戏训练自我对战批评家，以提高 LLM 推理评估。文本竞技场trains a self-play critic via adversarial games to improve LLM reasoning evaluation. TextArena(Guertler et al. 2025)提供超过 57 个基于文本的竞争性游戏环境的开源集合，以及用于 LLM 评估和自玩训练的 Gym 兼容 API。provides an open-source collection of 57+ competitive text-based game environments with a Gym-compatible API for LLM evaluation and self-play training.Sarkar et al. 2025使用多智能体强化学习训练法学硕士进行“我们之中”式的社会演绎。自我对弈与执行反馈train LLMs for Among Us-style social deduction with multi-agent RL. Self-Play with Execution Feedback(Dong et al. 2024)使用代码执行来验证自播放循环中的指令遵循。螺旋uses code execution to verify instruction-following in a self-play loop. SPIRAL(Liu et al. 2025a)引入了零和博弈的自我对弈作为多智能体、多轮强化学习框架，通过博弈论竞争来激励推理。香料introduces self-play on zero-sum games as a multi-agent, multi-turn RL framework that incentivizes reasoning through game-theoretic competition. SPICE(Liu et al. 2025b)通过信息不对称将自我游戏扩展到语料库环境：挑战者从大型语料库中挖掘文档，以生成具有基于文档的答案的各种推理任务，而推理者无需访问文档即可解决这些任务；该语料库可以防止在无根据的自我游戏中出现的幻觉放大和信息对称崩溃。瑞典-RLextends self-play to corpus environments via information asymmetry: a Challenger mines documents from a large corpus to generate diverse reasoning tasks with document-grounded answers, while a Reasoner solves them without document access; the corpus prevents hallucination amplification and information-symmetry collapse seen in ungrounded self-play. SWE-RL(Wei et al. 2026)将 RL 应用于开放软件演化任务，以及 SSRapplies RL to open software evolution tasks, and SSR(Wei et al. 2025)通过自我对弈来训练软件工程代理。锚定自我对弈trains software engineering agents through self-play. Anchored Self-Play(Choi et al. 2026)有一个单一模型，具有错误生成器和修复程序，用于代码修复，并具有难度带奖励，添加参考错误混合和嵌入相似性整形，以将自我生成的错误保留在实际分布上，防止偏离它，以及 GASPhas a single model play a bug-generator and a fixer for code repair with a difficulty-band reward, adding reference-bug mixing and embedding-similarity shaping to keep self-generated bugs on the realistic distribution, preventing drift off it, and GASP(Jana et al. 2026)指导以真实数据为基础的法学硕士编码的非对称自我对弈。guides asymmetric self-play for coding LLMs with grounding in real data.Chae et al. 2025提供了 LLM 自对弈何时成功、何时失败的系统分析，分析了生成质量受基本模型能力限制的“无形束缚”。provide a systematic analysis of when LLM self-play succeeds and when it fails, analyzing the “invisible leash” where generation quality is bounded by base-model capability.Shafayat et al. 2025研究大型推理模型是否可以自我训练，发现如果没有仔细的课程控制，幼稚的自我游戏会降低表现。investigate whether large reasoning models can self-train and find that naive self-play degrades performance without careful curriculum control.Liu et al. 2026b分析自合成自我博弈何时真正改善，表明持续进化需要合成管道来保证可学习的信息增益。analyze when self-synthetic self-play actually improves, showing that sustained evolution requires the synthetic pipeline to guarantee learnable information gain.

这组作品中出现了两个主题。首先，所有无数据的自我对弈方法都会生成Two themes emerge across this body of work. First, all data-free self-play methods generate任务tasks（问题陈述与稀疏的最终奖励配对）而不是具有状态转换的完整环境。其次，每个无数据情况下的生成器要么被冻结，要么通过启发式代理奖励（可学习性、难度、方差）进行训练，这可能会带来奖励黑客攻击和分布漂移的风险。相比之下，(a problem statement paired with a sparse terminal reward) rather than full environments with state transitions. Second, the generator in every data-free case is either frozen or trained with heuristic proxy rewards (learnability, difficulty, variance) that risk reward hacking and distributional drift. By contrast,黑桃SPADE产生generates完整的 MDP 环境full MDP environments（状态空间、转换函数、奖励函数和验证码）作为可执行的Python，并训练(state space, transition function, reward function, and verification code) as executable Python, and trains the环境设计师Environment Designer通过 RL 进行基于提示的后悔，该后悔是基于可测量的via RL with hint-based regret that is grounded in measured推理代理Reasoning Agent返回而不是代理统计。return rather than proxy statistics.

H.2 无监督环境设计和开放性Unsupervised Environment Design and Open-Endedness

课程学习Curriculum learning(Bengio et al. 2009)确立了从易到难对训练示例进行排序可以加速学习的原则。质量多样性 (QD) 算法，以 MAP-Elites 为例established the principle that ordering training examples from easy to hard accelerates learning. Quality-Diversity (QD) algorithms, exemplified by MAP-Elites(Mouret and Clune 2015)，通过在结构化行为空间中维护高性能解决方案的档案来照亮搜索空间，为许多开放式环境生成系统提供算法基础。配对开放式开拓者 (POET), illuminate the search space by maintaining an archive of high-performing solutions across a structured behavior space, providing the algorithmic substrate for many open-ended environment-generation systems. Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET)(Wang et al. 2019)开创了与智能体一起共同进化环境的范例，使用进化搜索来增长参数化 BipedalWalker 地形的群体以及解决它们的策略，并通过显式的迁移尝试在环境中移动高性能智能体。无监督环境设计（UED）通过自动生成训练环境而不是从固定池中进行选择来扩展这一想法。配对pioneered the paradigm of co-evolving environments alongside agents, using evolutionary search to grow a population of parameterized BipedalWalker terrains together with the policies that solve them, with explicit transfer attempts moving high-performing agents across environments. Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) extends this idea by automatically generating training environments instead of selecting from a fixed pool. PAIRED(Dennis et al. 2020)通过最小最大遗憾目标形式化 UED：对手生成环境参数，以最大化对手和主角回报之间的差距，产生越来越复杂的课程，同时避免无法解决的环境。formalized UED via a minimax regret objective: an adversary generates environment parameters to maximize the gap between an antagonist’s and a protagonist’s returns, producing curricula of increasing complexity while avoiding unsolvable environments.Dennis et al. 2020证明了在纳什均衡下，主角采取极小最大后悔策略，将UED与决策理论联系起来。优先关卡重播 (PLR)proved that at Nash equilibrium, the protagonist plays a minimax regret policy, connecting UED to decision theory. Prioritized Level Replay (PLR)(Jiang et al. 2021b)用优先考虑高遗憾级别的重播缓冲区替换了学习的对手，以较低的计算成本实现了可比的课程质量。重播引导的对抗环境设计replaced the learned adversary with a replay buffer that prioritizes high-regret levels, achieving comparable curriculum quality with lower computational cost. Replay-Guided Adversarial Environment Design(Jiang et al. 2021a)将对抗生成器与优先重播相结合，使用重播分布引导对手走向环境空间的高遗憾区域。加速器combined the adversarial generator with prioritized replay, using the replay distribution to guide the adversary toward high-regret regions of the environment space. ACCEL(Parker-Holder et al. 2022)引入了高遗憾级别的进化突变，在没有特定领域启发式的情况下增加了训练的复杂性，并以 POET 等基于群体的方法所需计算量的一小部分恢复了极小最大遗憾保证。introduced evolutionary mutations of high-regret levels, compounding complexity over training without domain-specific heuristics and recovering minimax regret guarantees at a fraction of the compute required by population-based methods like POET.Mediratta et al. 2023通过熵正则化和主角与对手之间的行为克隆来稳定配对式学习对手，解决破坏 UED 稳定性的熵崩溃问题。stabilized PAIRED-style learned adversaries via entropy regularization and behavioral cloning between protagonist and antagonist, addressing the entropy collapse that destabilizes UED.Rutherford et al. 2024研究了 PLR 和 ACCEL 中使用的后悔近似，表明常见代理（正值损失、最大蒙特卡罗）与成功率相关，而不是与真正的后悔相关，并提出可学习性采样（SFL）作为改进的估计器。investigated regret approximations used in PLR and ACCEL, showing that common proxies (positive value loss, maximum Monte Carlo) correlate with success rate rather than true regret, and proposing Sampling For Learnability (SFL) as an improved estimator.Monette et al. 2025将 UED 重新定义为分类级别分布上的非凸凹优化，证明收敛于一阶纳什均衡，并将可学习性分数推广到连续回报设置。中国电子工业协会recast UED as a nonconvex-concave optimization over a categorical level distribution, proving convergence to first-order Nash equilibria and generalizing learnability scores to continuous-return settings. CENIE(Teoh et al. 2024)增强基于遗憾的 UED 具有新颖性目标，该目标衡量候选环境将智能体推入状态行动空间的未探索区域的程度，发现新颖性和遗憾是协同作用而不是竞争。发现augmented regret-based UED with a novelty objective that measures how much a candidate environment pushes the agent into unexplored regions of the state-action space, finding that novelty and regret are synergistic rather than competing. DISCOVER(Diaz-Bone et al. 2026)提供了来自目标条件强化学习的补充形式分析视图：它通过平衡可实现性、相关性和新颖性的当前策略价值估计来对候选目标进行评分，并证明了目标实现时间的 UCB 式界限，该界限仅取决于智能体到目标的初始距离，与任务空间体积无关。三轴选择规则平行provides a complementary formal-analysis view from goal-conditioned RL: it scores candidate goals via current-policy value estimates balancing achievability, relevance, and novelty, and proves a UCB-style bound on time-to-target-achievability that depends only on the agent’s initial distance to the target, independent of task-space volume. The three-axis selection rule parallels黑桃SPADE基于提示的遗憾作为前沿目标课程信号，但 DISCOVER 在固定目标池上运行，而’s hint-based regret as a frontier-targeting curriculum signal, but DISCOVER operates over a fixed goal pool whereas黑桃SPADE生成环境分布本身。generates the environment distribution itself.

更广泛的开放性研究激发了对无限环境空间的需求。A broader thread of open-endedness research motivates the need for unbounded environment spaces.Hughes et al. 2024认为开放性（定义为同时具有新颖性和可学习性）对于超人人工智能至关重要，并且当环境参数化耗尽时，系统就会陷入停滞状态。argue that open-endedness, defined as simultaneous novelty and learnability, is essential for superhuman AI, and that systems plateau when the environment parameterization is exhausted.Baker et al. 2019展示了捉迷藏中多智能体自动课程的新兴工具的使用，表明丰富的物理环境中的竞争性自我游戏会产生越来越复杂的策略。奥米尼demonstrated emergent tool use from multi-agent autocurricula in hide-and-seek, showing that competitive self-play in rich physics environments produces increasingly sophisticated strategies. OMNI(Zhang et al. 2023)使用基础模型作为“兴趣模型”来过滤开放式任务建议，将课程重点放在既可学习又有趣的任务上。全能史诗uses foundation models as a “Model of Interestingness” to filter open-ended task proposals, focusing the curriculum on tasks that are both learnable and interesting. OMNI-EPIC(Faldor et al. 2024)通过将每个环境表示为由基础模型生成的可执行代码来扩展这条线，并使用冻结的 FM 判断兴趣门控生成的任务进入存档；extends this line by representing each environment as executable code generated by a foundation model, with a frozen FM judge of interestingness gating which generated tasks enter the archive;黑桃SPADE共享代码即环境表示，但训练shares the code-as-environment representation but trains the环境设计师Environment Designer通过 RL 进行基于提示的后悔，没有冻结的兴趣判断。想象中的自动课程via RL with hint-based regret, with no frozen interestingness judge. Imagined Autocurricula(Güzel et al. 2025)将 PLR 应用到从离线数据训练的学习扩散世界模型中，证明 UED 原理可以转移到想象的环境中。 SIMA 2applies PLR inside a learned diffusion world model trained from offline data, demonstrating that UED principles transfer to imagined environments. SIMA 2(Bolton et al. 2025)将开放式自我改进扩展到具体的 3D 世界：基于 Gemini 的代理使用基础模型来生成自己的任务和奖励，并在以前未见过的甚至模型生成的 (Genie 3) 环境中获得新技能，尽管它将过程分布在单独的任务设置者、代理和奖励模型之间，再加上一个独特的生成世界模型，而不是编写自己的环境的单一策略。scales open-ended self-improvement to embodied 3D worlds: a Gemini-based agent uses foundation models to generate its own tasks and rewards and acquires new skills in previously unseen and even model-generated (Genie 3) environments, though it distributes the process across separate task-setter, agent, and reward models plus a distinct generative world model instead of a single policy that authors its own environments.Goldfeder et al. 2026主张超人适应性智能而非 AGI，强调适应速度而非静态基准性能。辣椒粉argue for Superhuman Adaptable Intelligence over AGI, emphasizing speed of adaptation over static benchmark performance. PAPRIKA(Tajwar et al. 2025)在十个手工设计的任务组中训练普遍好奇的智能体，表明多样化的多轮训练产生可转移的探索策略。trains generally curious agents on ten hand-designed task groups, showing that diverse multi-turn training produces transferable exploration strategies.

所有经典的 UED 方法均在All classical UED methods operate in参数化的parameterized具有小型、固定设计词汇的环境空间（迷宫尺寸、地形摩擦力、网格布局）。据我们所知，environment spaces (maze dimensions, terrain friction, grid layouts) with small, fixed design vocabularies. To our knowledge,黑桃SPADE是第一个带来的系统is the first system to bring基于后悔的 UED 和经过 RL 训练的regret-based UED with an RL-trained环境设计师Environment Designer生成完整的 MDP 环境that produces full MDP environments到LLM后训练：环境空间是无界的（任意Python代码），to LLM post-training: the environment space is unbounded (arbitrary Python code), the环境设计师Environment Designer isLLM 而不是一个单独的对手网络，基于提示的后悔提供了共同进化信号，而不需要训练有素的对手。the LLM rather than a separate adversary network, and hint-based regret provides the co-evolution signal without requiring a trained antagonist.

H.3 合成环境生成Synthetic Environment Generation

越来越多的工作使用法学硕士以编程方式生成代理强化学习的训练环境，解决手动环境设计的瓶颈。特工世界模型（AWM）A growing body of work uses LLMs to programmatically generate training environments for agentic RL, addressing the bottleneck of hand-curated environment design. Agent World Model (AWM)(Wang et al. 2026b)将环境综合分解为五个阶段（场景、任务、数据库、接口、验证），以生成 1,000 个具有 MCP 接口的 SQLite 支持的工具使用环境，通过 GRPO 进行混合步骤级和任务级奖励的培训代理。缩放环境decomposes environment synthesis into five stages (scenario, task, database, interface, verification) to produce 1,000 SQLite-backed tool-use environments with MCP interfaces, training agents via GRPO with hybrid step-level and task-level rewards. ScaleEnv(Tu et al. 2026)通过综合 API 规范、数据库和来自种子域的验证代码来生成多轮工具使用环境，扩展到数千个环境以进行通用交互式代理训练。特米根generates multi-turn tool-use environments by synthesizing API specifications, databases, and verification code from seed domains, scaling to thousands of environments for generalist interactive agent training. TermiGen(Zhu et al. 2026)通过自动轨迹验证综合 Docker 容器内的高保真终端环境，为终端代理训练生成各种命令行任务。 Nemotron 终端synthesizes high-fidelity terminal environments inside Docker containers with automated trajectory verification, producing diverse command-line tasks for terminal agent training. Nemotron-Terminal(Pi et al. 2026)推出 Terminal-Task-Gen，这是一个两级管道，结合了introduces Terminal-Task-Gen, a two-stage pipeline that combines数据集适应dataset adaptation（将数学、代码和 SWE 基准转换为终端格式的提示）(transforming math, code, and SWE benchmarks into terminal-formatted prompts) with合成任务生成synthetic task generation（基于种子和基于技能，后者由九个领域和原始技能的技能分类驱动）；最终的 Terminal-Corpus 是开源的，通过 SFT 进行后训练的 Qwen3-32B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到了 27.4%（基线为 3.4%），在参数数量的一小部分上超过了 Qwen3-Coder-480B (23.9%)。技能合成器(seed-based and skill-based, the latter driven by a Skill Taxonomy of nine domains and primitive skills); the resulting Terminal-Corpus is open-sourced, and Qwen3-32B post-trained via SFT reaches 27.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (from a 3.4% baseline), surpassing Qwen3-Coder-480B (23.9%) at a fraction of the parameter count. SkillSynth(Fan et al. 2026)构建了一个以场景为中介的技能图，其中 82,073 个场景作为节点，57,214 个过滤技能作为定向转换，以及 185,529 个 LLM 验证的桥，将通过该图的定向路径采样作为工作流抽象，并通过具有基于执行和基于规则的双重验证的多代理工具将它们实例化（95.7% 的预言机通过率，每次运行 3,560 个经过验证的任务实例）；明确的目标是最大化原始任务数上执行轨迹的多样性。尤里卡宇宙constructs a scenario-mediated skill graph with 82,073 scenarios as nodes, 57,214 filtered skills as directed transitions, and 185,529 LLM-verified bridges, samples directed paths through the graph as workflow abstractions, and instantiates them via a multi-agent harness with dual execution-based and rubric-based verification (95.7% oracle pass rate, 3,560 verified task instances per run); the explicit objective is maximizing the diversity of execution trajectories over raw task count. Eurekaverse(Liang et al. 2024)使用 LLM 生成用于机器人技能学习的 Python 地形程序课程（高度场函数），在代理性能反馈的指导下生成逐渐困难的物理环境，并在四足跑酷上进行验证。沙盒法学硕士uses LLMs to generate Python terrain-program curricula (height-field functions) for robot skill learning, producing progressively harder physics environments guided by agent performance feedback, and validates on quadrupedal parkour. LLM-in-Sandbox(Cheng et al. 2026)将法学硕士置于沙盒代码执行环境中，并表明代理智能是从与可执行反馈的多轮交互中产生的。 EvoCUAplaces LLMs in sandboxed code-execution environments and shows that agentic intelligence emerges from multi-turn interaction with executable feedback. EvoCUA(Xue et al. 2026a)通过综合可扩展的 GUI 交互体验来发展计算机使用代理，并在不同的桌面应用程序中生成训练轨迹。evolves computer-use agents by synthesizing scalable GUI interaction experiences, generating training trajectories across diverse desktop applications.Xue et al. 2026b将其扩展到自主持续学习，其中计算机使用代理通过自我生成的经验适应新环境。梦想健身房extend this to autonomous continual learning where computer-use agents adapt to new environments through self-generated experience. DreamGym(Chen et al. 2025e)在现有代理环境（WebShop、ALFWorld、WebArena）的演示轨迹上训练基于 LLM 的世界模型，并使用它生成抽象文本推出，以取代 RL 期间昂贵的真实环境交互。西米亚trains an LLM-based world model on demonstration trajectories from existing agentic environments (WebShop, ALFWorld, WebArena) and uses it to generate abstract-text rollouts that replace expensive real-environment interactions during RL. Synthetic Sandbox(Zhou et al. 2026)生成沙盒 ML 工程环境，用于根据实际的开发工作流程培训软件代理。 RL任何东西generates sandboxed ML-engineering environments for training software agents on realistic development workflows. Agent-World(Dong et al. 2026)从网络内容（1,978 个环境、19,822 个工具）中挖掘真实环境和工具集，并应用自我进化的训练环境来诊断智能体的弱点并跨轮生成有针对性的任务。代理缩放器mines real-world environments and toolsets from web content (1,978 environments, 19,822 tools) and applies a self-evolving training arena that diagnoses agent weaknesses and generates targeted tasks across rounds. AgentScaler(Fang et al. 2025a)通过参数相似性图上的 Louvain 社区检测，将超过 30,000 个真实 API 聚类到 1,000 多个模拟工具使用域中，将每个工具具体化为在每个域数据库模式上运行的 Python 类，并通过对过滤后的代理用户轨迹进行两阶段监督微调来训练 4B/8B/30B-A3B 代理，无需 RL。环境缩放器clusters over 30,000 real APIs into more than 1,000 simulated tool-use domains via Louvain community detection on a parameter-similarity graph, materializes each tool as a Python class operating on a per-domain database schema, and trains 4B/8B/30B-A3B agents via two-phase supervised fine-tuning on filtered agent-user trajectories without RL. EnvScaler(Song et al. 2026)以编程方式合成工具交互环境，用于多轮工具使用代理训练，以及 EnvFactoryprogrammatically synthesizes tool-interactive environments for multi-turn tool-use agent training, and EnvFactory(Xu et al. 2026b)扩展可执行工具使用环境综合与稳定的强化学习配方。从实习生到培训师scales executable tool-use environment synthesis paired with a stable RL recipe. From Trainee to Trainer(Chen et al. 2026)通过让当前的 RL 检查点根据训练轮中诊断出的故障重新配置自己的环境生成器，缩小了适应性差距，尽管它调整了一组固定的生成器参数并且不发出可执行的环境代码。自动播放narrows the adaptivity gap by letting the current RL checkpoint reconfigure its own environment generator from diagnosed failures across training rounds, though it tunes a fixed set of generator parameters and does not emit executable environment code. AutoPlay(Ramrakhya et al. 2025)通过首先在每个应用程序中运行 MLLM 浏览器来收集状态和功能信息，然后在这些探索轨迹上设置冻结的 GPT-4o 任务生成器条件，并根据任务指南提示来提出接地任务，从而解决 UI 代理（移动和桌面）的任务合成问题；执行器通过 SFT 和 GRPO 进行训练，并获得 MLLM 验证者的二元结果奖励，在 AndroidWorld 上比 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 获得 20.6 分。无限网addresses task synthesis for UI agents (mobile and desktop) by first running an MLLM explorer in each app to gather state and functionality information, then having a frozen GPT-4o task-generator condition on those exploration trajectories plus task-guideline prompts to propose grounded tasks; the executor is trained via SFT and GRPO with binary outcome rewards from an MLLM verifier, gaining 20.6 points on AndroidWorld over Qwen2.5-VL-7B. InfiniteWeb(Zhang et al. 2026e)通过以任务为中心的测试驱动开发，综合完整的静态 HTML/localStorage 网站以及任务和密集奖励 JavaScript 评估器； UI-TARS-1.5-7B 使用 GRPO 对 600 个生成的任务进行后训练，在 OSWorld 上从 24.5 提高到 31.4，在 Online-Mind2Web 上从 23.0 提高到 28.7，最大的增益集中在简单和中等难度的部分。进化环境synthesizes complete static-HTML/localStorage websites alongside tasks and dense-reward JavaScript evaluators via task-centric test-driven development; UI-TARS-1.5-7B post-trained with GRPO on 600 generated tasks improves on OSWorld from 24.5 to 31.4 and on Online-Mind2Web from 23.0 to 28.7, with the largest gains concentrated in easy and medium difficulty buckets. EvoEnv(Shi et al. 2026)通过共享参数 GRPO 在生成器和求解器角色调节下共同训练单个 LLM，生成可重用的 Python 验证器和提示工件，其预言机和记分器在训练时保持冻结状态；生成器奖励结合了分阶段验证、以 30% 求解器精度为目标的求解器相对难度校准和基于嵌入的新颖性奖励，以及对仅限于单次推理基准的三个模型系列的评估（Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 在八个数学、代码和科学基准上的平均值从 72.4 提高到 74.8）。环境接口是单次评分（采样器、预言机、渲染器、记分器），没有状态演化或步骤级奖励，因此该框架无法扩展到多轮代理设置，例如工具使用或终端工作流程；co-trains a single LLM under generator and solver role-conditioning via shared-parameter GRPO, producing reusable Python verifier-and-prompt artifacts whose oracle and scorer remain frozen at training time; the generator reward combines staged validation, solver-relative difficulty calibration targeting 30% solver accuracy, and an embedding-based novelty bonus, with evaluation on three model families restricted to single-shot reasoning benchmarks (Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 improves from 72.4 to 74.8 averaged across eight math, code, and science benchmarks). The environment interface is single-shot scoring (sampler, oracle, renderer, scorer) without state evolution or step-level rewards, so the framework does not extend to multi-turn agentic settings such as tool use or terminal workflows;黑桃SPADE不同之处在于三个方面： (i)differs in three respects: (i) the环境设计师Environment Designer通过基于暗示的遗憾获得奖励is rewarded via hint-based regret grounded in推理代理Reasoning Agent返回而不是验证和新颖性信号，(ii) 环境是完整的 MDP，具有统一单轮和多轮设置的重置/步骤接口，以及 (iii) 除了推理之外，评估还涵盖游戏和工具的使用。return rather than validation and novelty signals, (ii) environments are full MDPs with reset/step interfaces that unify single-turn and multi-turn settings, and (iii) evaluation spans games and tool use in addition to reasoning.

这些方法产生有用的培训材料，其中一些方法结合了反馈驱动的适应，其中生成分布根据代理进度而变化：Eurekaverse 根据代理性能统计数据演化环境，而 EvoCUA 通过改进策略迭代综合。然而，即使在这些情况下，生成器 LLM 也不会收到 RL 梯度；适应通过提示启发法或迭代数据过滤来进行，无需联合优化。相比之下，These methods produce useful training material, and some incorporate feedback-driven adaptation where the generation distribution shifts in response to agent progress: Eurekaverse evolves environments based on agent performance statistics, and EvoCUA iterates synthesis with an improving policy. However, even in these cases the generator LLM receives no RL gradients; adaptation operates through prompting heuristics or iterative data filtering, without joint optimization. By contrast,黑桃SPADE’s 环境设计师Environment Designer是一个真正的 RL 学习者，通过基于提示的后悔在与is a genuine RL learner, trained via hint-based regret in the same optimization loop as the推理代理Reasoning Agent，在以下位置生成完整的 MDP 环境, producing full MDP environments at the推理代理Reasoning Agent的能力边界。’s competence frontier.

H.4 环境缩放Environment Scaling

越来越多的共识认为，代理强化学习的下一个前沿是扩展环境而不是算法。A growing consensus holds that the next frontier for agentic RL is scaling environments rather than algorithms.Silver and Sutton 2025最直接地阐明了这一愿景，认为该领域正在进入一个“体验时代”，其中主要瓶颈是产生足够多样化和丰富的培训环境。articulate this vision most directly, arguing that the field is entering an “era of experience” in which the primary bottleneck is generating sufficiently diverse and abundant training environments.Zhang et al. 2026b以同样的方式认为，可扩展、多样化的环境是驱动通用代理的因素。代理RLargue in the same vein that scalable, diverse environments are what drive generalizable agents. AgentRL(Zhang et al. 2025a)提供多回合、多任务 RL 框架，具有完全异步的生成训练管道、用于改进探索的跨策略采样以及任务优势标准化，跨五个代理域训练单个代理以超越前沿模型。缩放器provides a multi-turn, multi-task RL framework with a fully asynchronous generation-training pipeline, cross-policy sampling for improved exploration, and task advantage normalization, training a single agent across five agentic domains to outperform frontier models. SCALER(Xu et al. 2026a)将竞争性编程问题（来自 CodeContests）转换为受控难度级别的参数化单轮推理环境，证明扩展训练问题的数量和多样性可以带来数学推理的持续改进。右室静脉曲张converts competitive programming problems (from CodeContests) into parameterized single-turn reasoning environments at controlled difficulty levels, demonstrating that scaling the number and diversity of training problems yields consistent improvements in mathematical reasoning. RLVE(Zeng et al. 2025)创建 400 个手工设计的可验证环境，用于 RL 训练，具有自适应难度级别和每个环境的自定义验证器（混合基于规则的解析、软评分和代码执行），以代替法学硕士作为法官。 WebScale-RLcreates 400 hand-engineered verifiable environments for RL training with adaptive difficulty levels and per-environment custom verifiers (mixing rule-based parsing, soft scoring, and code execution) in place of LLM-as-judge. WebScale-RL(Cen et al. 2025)构建了一个自动化数据管道，用于收集 Web 内容以创建预训练规模的 RL 训练环境，这表明更多样化的环境可以产生更好的泛化能力。无尽的终端builds an automated data pipeline that harvests web content to create RL training environments at pretraining scale, showing that more diverse environments produce better generalization. Endless Terminals(Gandhi et al. 2026)通过四阶段管道在程序上生成 3,255 个经过验证的终端使用任务，并证明具有二元奖励的普通 PPO 随着训练环境数量的扩展（转移到 TerminalBench 2.0）会产生巨大的收益。自我发展的课程procedurally generates 3,255 verified terminal-use tasks via a four-stage pipeline and demonstrates that vanilla PPO with binary rewards yields substantial gains as the number of training environments scales, with transfer to TerminalBench 2.0. Self-Evolving Curriculum(Chen et al. 2025d)根据学习者当前的表现动态调整训练问题的难度分布，防止简单示例饱和。 TTCSdynamically adjusts the difficulty distribution of training problems based on the learner’s current performance, preventing saturation on easy examples. TTCS(Yang et al. 2026)通过 GRPO 共同进化梯度训练的问题合成器与求解器，使用针对测试时求解器学习前沿的能力自适应奖励。co-evolves a gradient-trained problem synthesizer with a solver via GRPO, using a capability-adaptive reward that targets the solver’s learning frontier at test time.Xu et al. 2025调查通往大型推理模型的道路，将该领域分为三个支柱（自动数据构建、通过强化学习进行推理学习和测试时间扩展），并将环境扩展确定为一个关键的开放问题。survey the path toward Large Reasoning Models, organizing the field into three pillars (automated data construction, learning-to-reason via RL, and test-time scaling) and identifying environment scaling as a key open problem.Song et al. 2024检查法学硕士的自我完善能力，发现幼稚的自我培训很快就会饱和，从而激发了对适应性课程的需求。体现协同设计examine self-improvement capabilities of LLMs and find that naive self-training saturates quickly, motivating the need for adaptive curricula. Embodied Co-Design(Wang et al. 2025b)提供了协同设计方法的分类，其中代理形态和控制器共同进化，与provides a taxonomy of co-design approaches where agent morphology and controller evolve jointly, drawing parallels to黑桃SPADE环境和智能体的共同进化。代理通过早期经验学习’s co-evolution of environment and agent. Agent Learning via Early Experience(Zhang et al. 2025c)引入了一种无奖励的训练范式，其中智能体在专家访问的状态下提出替代行动，并从由此产生的未来状态中学习（隐式世界建模和自我反思），在八个智能体环境中架起模仿学习和全面强化学习的桥梁。introduces a reward-free training paradigm in which agents propose alternative actions at expert-visited states and learn from the resulting future states (implicit world modeling and self-reflection), bridging imitation learning and full RL across eight agentic environments.

这些作品独立地证明了更多的环境可以产生更好的泛化能力，并且课程设计至少与算法选择一样重要。其中一些包含自适应机制：RLVE 调整每个环境的难度级别，SCALER 跟踪难度控制的准确性，自我进化课程学习针对问题类别的采样策略。These works independently demonstrate that more environments yield better generalization and that curriculum design matters at least as much as algorithm choice. Several incorporate adaptive mechanisms: RLVE adjusts per-environment difficulty levels, SCALER tracks accuracy for difficulty control, and Self-Evolving Curriculum learns a sampling policy over problem categories.黑桃SPADE将梯度训练的环境设计与代码即环境表示相结合，生成可执行 MDP 的自适应课程，与combines gradient-trained environment design with the code-as-environment representation, producing an adaptive curriculum of executable MDPs that co-evolves with the推理代理Reasoning Agent.

H.5 代理内存设计和自我改进的代码系统Agentic Memory Design and Self-Improving Code Systems

内存RLMemRL(Zhang et al. 2026d)引入了自我进化代理，通过运行时强化学习对情景记忆进行学习，存储和检索过去的交互经验，以改进未来的决策，而无需额外的梯度更新。阿尔玛introduces self-evolving agents that learn via runtime reinforcement learning on episodic memory, storing and retrieving past interaction experiences to improve future decision-making without additional gradient updates. ALMA(Xiong et al. 2026)元学习代理内存设计本身：基础模型搜索 Python 内存架构程序的空间（更新/检索操作的开放式支架），发现可改善测试时持续学习的内存设计。超级代理meta-learns agentic memory designs themselves: a foundation model searches the space of Python memory-architecture programs (an open-ended scaffold over update/retrieve operations), discovering memory designs that improve continual learning at test time. HyperAgents(Zhang et al. 2026a)通过将任务解决器和元改进器融合到单个可编辑程序中来扩展自引用代码演化，因此自修改机制本身是可修改的；任务是外部固定的，基础模型是冻结的。这些方向是互补的extends self-referential code evolution by fusing the task-solver and the meta-improver into a single editable program, so the self-modification mechanism is itself modifiable; tasks are externally fixed and the foundation model is frozen. These directions are complementary to黑桃SPADE：他们解决了代理如何: they address how agents使用use积累的经验或accumulated experience or重写自己的脚手架rewrite their own scaffolding在元层面上，同时at the meta-level, while黑桃SPADE解决如何addresses how to生成generate首先通过强化学习产生这种体验的训练环境。 HyperAgents 明确地将共同进化任务分配作为未来的工作，这the training environments that produce that experience in the first place via RL. HyperAgents explicitly leaves co-evolving the task distribution as future work, which黑桃SPADE直接地址。这些方法是可组合的：addresses directly. The approaches are composable:黑桃SPADE的自适应环境生成可以填充 ALMA 式记忆系统和 MemRL 式运行时 RL 操作的经验流。’s adaptive environment generation could populate the experience streams that ALMA-style memory systems and MemRL-style runtime RL operate over.

范围和限制。Scope and limitations.

每个环境的标量奖励不会保留在公共运行日志中，因此可学习性是在步骤级别（获胜率、可学习带分数）而不是按环境来衡量的；法学硕士的标准衡量的是绝对难度和连贯性，而不是适合当前的代理人；可执行性是在管道消毒剂上游的原始代上测量的。多样性数字使用批量大小 24，并对较大的引导步骤批量进行二次采样以进行比较。Per-environment scalar rewards are not retained in the public run log, so learnability is measured at the step level (win rate, learnable-band fraction) rather than per environment; the LLM rubric measures absolute difficulty and coherence rather than fit to the current agent; and executability is measured on raw generations, upstream of the pipeline’s sanitizer. Diversity numbers use batch size 24 with larger boot-step batches subsampled for comparability.

J.2 工具使用Tool Use

工具使用The tool-use环境设计师Environment Designer发出与游戏设置不同的寄存器中的环境：每个环境都是一个模拟的 API 域（银行、零售订单、支持票证、电信帐户、智能家居控制），其中用户一次发出一个原子指令，并且仅当隐藏状态上的编程标准确认当前指令已完成时，环境才会前进。下面的卡片完全按照生成的方式再现了一个早期环境和一个晚期环境：代码语料库片段为生成提供了种子，emits environments in a different register from the games setting: each is a simulated API domain (banking, retail orders, support tickets, telecom accounts, smart-home control) in which a user issues one atomic instruction at a time, and the environment advances only when a programmatic criterion over the hidden state confirms the current instruction is complete. The cards below reproduce one early and one late environment exactly as generated: a code-corpus snippet seeds the generation, the环境设计师Environment Designer在其之上构建一个不相关的日常域，并且每个用户指令都与后端状态上的可检查标准配对（在早期的卡片中，将工具调用的来源与其状态效果耦合起来）。标准检查显着态效应；说明文本中的限定符（例如哪个帐户支付发票）并不总是绑定的，这是验证检查无法捕获的工件。builds an unrelated everyday domain on top of it, and each user instruction is paired with a checkable criterion over the backend state (in the early card, coupling the tool call’s provenance with its state effect). Criteria check the salient state effect; qualifiers in the instruction text, such as which account pays an invoice, are not always bound, an artifact the validation checks do not catch.

在整个 30B 运行中，生成环境的结构轮廓是固定的，反映了游戏设置的分布平稳性（附录Across the full 30B run the structural profile of generated environments is stationary, mirroring the distributional stationarity of the games setting (AppendixI.1.2): 平均程序长度从): mean program length moves from247247 to 226226第一个和最后一个训练带之间的线，每个环境的工具来自lines between the first and last training band, tools per environment from7.67.6 to 5.95.9，而每个环境的说明（, while instructions per environment (4.74.7）和每步标准的逻辑复杂度（) and the logical complexity of the per-step criteria (1.91.9 to 2.02.0每个标准的条件）保持不变，并且大约五分之一的环境会提供受保护的故障路径（卡锁定、代理不可用、请求被拒绝），conditions per criterion) stay flat, and roughly one environment in five ships a guarded failure path (locked cards, unavailable agents, denied requests) that the推理代理Reasoning Agent必须检测并从中恢复。训练中改变的不是脚手架，而是通过它旋转的实例化：must detect and recover from. What changes over training is not the scaffold but the instantiations rotated through it: the环境设计师Environment Designer拥有日常 API 域的稳定库存，同时每轮重新生成新的状态、标识符和指令序列，这正是语料库基础和内存组件旨在维持的机制。holds a stable inventory of everyday API domains while regenerating fresh states, identifiers, and instruction sequences each round, exactly the regime the corpus-grounding and memory components are designed to sustain.
